# Stadswandelkantoor

Official Open Rondleidingen catalogue: <https://www.stadswandelkantoor.nl/nieuw>. The page says these are open tours available for signup. It lists the Buiksloterham–Ceuvel–Schoonschip walk at €17.50 per person and says open-tour payment is cash on site. Its public signup form showed no individual date or start during the 18 October 2026 check, so this is an undated offer only.

The English tour overview is <https://www.stadswandelkantoor.nl/english>; it describes history and architecture walks but does not explicitly state the spoken language of this open departure. Keep `languages: []` unless the organizer names the language. Do not use the €17.50 private/group or tour price to invent an event date. Recheck the Open Rondleidingen page for a specific individually listed weekend/evening date, start, meeting place and language before creating a dated event.
